items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Johnny Pijos. He could never play, couldn't he Pijos?

ctx.x: Well, he used to have more Valtrombones than his musicians. You don't hardly see them anymore. Johnny Pijos.

Johnny Pijos. He could never play, couldn't he Pijos? No. Eddie Mayer. Big Nose. Oh, Big Nose. No, Eddie Mayer. Come here. He's just nice. Trying to make a comeback. Yeah, a bit nice. Yeah, Eddie Mayer. Johnny Pijos or something like that. Polizzi, but poor Joe could never play. Joe, no. Oh, poor Joe. Yeah. Good play. Good play. Yeah. Played by the ball.
Was there a colored union back or another time when Buddy Bober was operating? No.
